an3.155:1.1: ye bhikkhave, sattā pubbanhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, supubbanho bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
an3.155:2.1: ye hi bhikkhave, sattā majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, sumajjhantiko bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
an3.155:3.1: ye hi bhikkhave, sattā sāyanhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, susāyanho bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānanti.
